newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB says to raise May debenture coupon to 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: LTCB says to raise May debenture coupon to 2.5 pct.

text.p: The Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) said on Tuesday it would raise the coupon rate of its May five-year bank debenture to 2.5 percent from 1.9 percent in April.
The coupon rate for the May debenture will be the highest since August 1996, when the coupon rate for LTCB's five-year debenture was set at 2.6 percent.
LTCB also said it would raise its long-term prime lending rate for May by 0.6 percentage point to 3.1 percent.
The prime rate, which is also a key reference rate for other banks making long-term loans, was cut by 0.2 point to a record low 2.5 percent in December and had remained unchanged since then.
LTCB's April bank debentures with a coupon rate of 1.9 percent were traded at 2.57 percent on Monday.
